slides.title: *Grade* your relationship
slides.sub: Six subjects. Be honest. Comment your report card.

slides.subject: Communication
slides.prompt: Do you say what you mean, and *actually listen?*

slides.subject: Teamwork
slides.prompt: Chores, plans, decisions. Do you *show up together?*

slides.subject: Romance
slides.note: Strong start. Needs more surprise flowers.

slides.subject: Laughing together
slides.note: Disrupts class with inside jokes. A+ energy.

slides.subject: Snack sharing
slides.prompt: Do you share fries *without being asked?*
slides.note: Says “I’m not hungry.” Eats half my plate.

slides.title: Save this *and grade again in a month.*
slides.sub: Then comment your report card: A, B, B, A, C, A…
